sphere_commentary.overview:
The data reveal generally positive outcomes across all series, with notable variability in TRANSFORMING and some mismatches between observed scores and model predictions.
• HEALING shows the highest mean (6.98) and the most stable variance.
• THRIVING attains high scores in Focus & Clarity, especially T-FC-L3.
• TRANSFORMING displays lower means and greater spread, particularly in ASCENT protocols.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
Series‑level patterns align with design intents while highlighting imbalances in efficacy and engagement.
• HEALING delivers consistent, high‑scoring DESCENT protocols; anxiety and overstimulation entries exceed model expectations.
• THRIVING’s HOLD designs excel in Focus & Clarity and Creative Flow, though some protocols under‑perform relative to predictions.
• TRANSFORMING’s ASCENT arcs show the greatest variance and several protocols fall short of AutoGluon’s high predicted scores.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Several protocols deviate from expected patterns, warranting closer inspection.
• H-CR-L1 (Anchor) records a mean of 6.35 despite a high predicted crisis score (7.955), suggesting limited entrainment.
• X-MC-L3 (Cosmos) shows a low observed mean (5.70) versus a strong mind‑clarity prediction (7.538).
• T-CF-L3 (Aurora) exceeds its predicted creative‑flow score (7.288 vs 6.79), indicating possible subgroup benefit.
• Bimodal or skewed distributions appear in T-MB-L3 and T-FC-L3, hinting at population splits.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Targeted refinements could improve alignment between outcomes and predictions.
• Adjust adviser routing for X-ME-L1 (n=39) to better match listeners’ expectations and capture its high predicted efficacy.
• Increase the hold phase for X-MD-L1 (n=22) where observed outcomes (6.36) fall far short of the motivation prediction (7.876).
• Create an L2 variant of H-CR-L1 (n=43) to explore whether a longer descent improves crisis relief.
• Investigate population splits in T-MB-L3 (n=14) where half the respondents report rapid improvement and half do not settle.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding drift and clustering highlight evolving analytical frames and protocol relationships.
• CROSS‑RUN DRIFT: 28 of 30 protocols show notable drift (similarity < 0.85), especially X‑MD‑L3 (0.507) and H‑SL‑L1 (0.530).
• CROSS‑PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: Strong intra‑series pairs (e.g., T‑FC‑L1/L2) and unexpected cross‑zone similarity of H‑OS‑L3 with sleep protocols.
• Confidence note: Drift analysis spans ten runs, providing sufficient basis, though deeper historical data would strengthen stability assessments.
